title: THE HOWLER REDESIGN
why: His order of 2026-10-12: improve the sprites of all characters and machines, silhouettes first. The Howler was a black lunchbox with a tube stuck in it at a fixed angle: the darkest thing in the cast, gone on a dark floor, and its mortar pointed up and left whatever it was shooting at. Now it is a mortar walker on four short splayed legs that step as it moves, with a light turret ring on top so it reads on dark floors, a fat tube with a yellow muzzle ring that leans toward whatever it faces, an ammo drum on its side and a spotting lamp that shows its mood. Elite Howlers have a brass muzzle ring. Drawn only: its size and its shots are unchanged.
now: The Howler is redrawn: a four-legged mortar walker whose fat tube turns toward what it is shooting at.
